openFindings.title: No workflow step records the files a commit-range target touches, so documented touched-file relevance narrowing never engages and admission keeps any scope
The review novelty ratio divides by the accumulated weighted total, so late in an expansive run even an iteration that finds a new issue reads as no progress and exhausts the node
dedupeKey drops every non-ASCII letter, so a non-Latin question is pruned as a duplicate and accented questions collide
Proposal scope is only prefix-checked, so free text after an in-target path passes relevance and reaches later FRONTIER blocks outside the untrusted-content guard
Proposal budget accepts any finite number, so a negative or fractional budget is stored and prunes every later child that names a positive one
Review presentation still counts the four canonical dimensions in the expansive budget and node universe after the universe was narrowed
The --extend warning names only all_dimensions_clean, but an expansive run with a drained frontier re-stops at once on frontier_drained
Comment claims a node is never held open for a dimension the stop does not owe, false for a canonical subset, and excluded dimensions are dispatched per node
The --depth-mode flag row is a 486-word table cell restating rules kept elsewhere, and the seed step is written out twice in the review YAML
The traceability-narrowed node universe reached only review.md, the YAML and the reducer comment; nine other live surfaces still say the four canonical dimensions plus any custom name
Both live two-node frontier playbooks wait for a confirm-mode stop before the frontier seed step that the workflow does not have
An open-ended git range (main.., ..HEAD, origin/main...) is read as a path, so on a single-executor run the seed and every proposal are pruned as relevance
Stuck pseudo-code in the review convergence reference uses a strict comparison while the code is inclusive; the 0.05 boundary decided a node close in this run

Graphless fallback gate counts a ledger row only with row-level evidenceRefs and five method names, but the prompt pack contract and example put evidence only inside searchActions and name exact_search

nodes.question: Is the frontier admission engine correct, minimal and portable: seed, admit, close, block and budget commands, the six admission checks, band budgets, the derived iteration budget and the commit-range relevance test?

Is the operator-facing command surface for /deep:review and /deep:research clear and consistent: the flag table, --extend, --depth-mode=expansive and the frontier cap flags, setup resolution, dry-run, usage errors and the YAML steps that run them?

Do the skill docs, references, playbooks, feature catalogs and the deep-review and deep-research agent definitions with their .claude, .codex, .pi, .dsh and .vibe mirrors describe what the code does, the same way on every runtime?

Does any workflow step give a commit-range review target its touched-file list before frontier admission reads reviewScopeFiles, and do the range-token heuristics hold for the targets operators actually write?
